description: Add components, connections, sticky notes and zones in the same sketchy style (marked as drawn by the interviewer). Use sparingly — the candidate should drive. Component kinds: user (User), browser (Web App), mobile (Mobile App), dns (DNS), cdn (CDN), lb (Load Balancer), gateway (API Gateway), firewall (Rate Limiter), server (App Server), service (Service), worker (Worker), lambda (Function), cron (Scheduler), sql (SQL DB), nosql (NoSQL DB), cache (Cache), storage (Object Store), search (Search Index), warehouse (Data Warehouse), queue (Queue), stream (Event Stream), pubsub (Pub/Sub), notify (Notifications), auth (Auth), monitor (Monitoring), ml (ML Model), external (External API). Connections reference a component by its ref/label (new or existing) or id. Positions are optional (auto-laid out to the right of existing content).
